sections.heading: C — Credential maintenance and required testing
sections.markdown:
## C — Credential maintenance and required testing

FACT_ID: sec03-F01 | anchor: A28
An applicant may request a medical-condition notation on the credential to alert people helping during an emergency. [A28]
Source: [A28 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec03-F02 | anchor: A28
A permanent-disability notation requires a permanent qualifying impairment certified in writing by a licensed physician, physician assistant or advanced-practice professional nurse. [A28]
Source: [A28 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec03-F03 | anchor: A28
A permanent-disability notation also requires ITD to determine that the applicant meets the remaining credential requirements. [A28]
Source: [A28 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec03-F04 | anchor: A28
A person with a non-expiring disability placard or disability plate may present its registration to request the permanent-disability credential notation. [A28]
Source: [A28 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0028]

FACT_ID: sec03-F05 | anchor: A29
To change the credential name, an applicant must request a duplicate or make the change during an eligible renewal. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec03-F06 | anchor: A29
A credential name change requires legal evidence such as an Idaho-standard certified marriage record, a court-certified divorce decree or court documents. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec03-F07 | anchor: A29
Before applying for a duplicate to show a changed name, update the name with the Social Security Administration. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec03-F08 | anchor: A29
A change of address must be reported to ITD within thirty days. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec03-F09 | anchor: A29
A changed address appears on the physical credential only after a duplicate application or eligible renewal. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec03-F10 | anchor: A29
The driving record must contain the actual physical address even when a different mailing address is used. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec03-F11 | anchor: A29
A post office box, general delivery, highway-contract route or rural route may be used as a mailing address. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec03-F12 | anchor: A29
A credential holder must not lend a license, instruction permit or identification card to someone else. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec03-F13 | anchor: A29
A person must not use another person’s license, instruction permit or identification card. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec03-F14 | anchor: A29
A person must not possess or display a fraudulent or altered driving credential or identification card. [A29]
Source: [A29 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0029]

FACT_ID: sec03-F15 | anchor: A30
A canceled license, permit or identification card must not be retained. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec03-F16 | anchor: A30
A vehicle owner must not give an unlicensed driver permission to drive the vehicle. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec03-F17 | anchor: A30
When an owner permits an unlicensed driver to drive, both are responsible for resulting crash damage, injury or death. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec03-F18 | anchor: A30
A Class D holder aged twenty-one or older may renew in person as early as twenty-five months before expiration. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec03-F19 | anchor: A30
An Idaho license renewal can run for four years, eight years or the remainder of the holder’s lawful stay. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec03-F20 | anchor: A30
A Class D holder aged twenty-one through sixty-two may choose the eight-year renewal. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec03-F21 | anchor: A30
Every license renewal requires vision screening. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec03-F22 | anchor: A30
Failed renewal vision screening may require an eye specialist to complete a vision examination form. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec03-F23 | anchor: A30
A renewal may require a medical examination form because of a prior condition or an examiner’s observation. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec03-F24 | anchor: A30
An Idaho or other-state Class D license expired at least twenty-five months requires the applicable knowledge and skills tests. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec03-F25 | anchor: A31
If a lost driver license or identification card is found after a duplicate has been issued, the old document must be destroyed or surrendered to the county license office. [A31]
Source: [A31 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec03-F26 | anchor: A31
The newly issued duplicate driver license or identification card is the document the holder should retain. [A31]
Source: [A31 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec03-F27 | anchor: A31
The expiration birthday is shown on the Idaho driver’s license. [A31]
Source: [A31 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec03-F28 | anchor: A31
A holder temporarily outside Idaho at expiration may apply for an extension of up to twelve months. [A31]
Source: [A31 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec03-F29 | anchor: A31
Under the ordinary temporary-out-of-state extension process, a holder may reapply for one additional and final twelve-month extension if needed. [A31]
Source: [A31 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec03-F30 | anchor: A31
Active-duty United States military members and their dependents may apply for as many extensions as needed during the active-duty period. [A31]
Source: [A31 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec03-F31 | anchor: A31
A newcomer who has lost a valid other-state driver license or identification card must provide documentation to help verify identity. [A31]
Source: [A31 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0031]

FACT_ID: sec03-F32 | anchor: A32
An applicant must be at least fifteen to take the knowledge and skills tests. [A32]
Source: [A32 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec03-F33 | anchor: A32
The minimum vision standard is twenty-forty in at least one eye, with corrective lenses permitted. [A32]
Source: [A32 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec03-F34 | anchor: A32
Using glasses or contacts for the vision screening results in a lens restriction on the license. [A32]
Source: [A32 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec03-F35 | anchor: A32
A driver with a lens restriction must wear the required glasses or contacts whenever driving. [A32]
Source: [A32 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec03-F36 | anchor: A32
Ignoring the required lens restriction can lead to a citation and suspension of driving privileges. [A32]
Source: [A32 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec03-F37 | anchor: A32
A county DMV agent may require a physician’s medical form before licensing when a condition could affect safe driving. [A32]
Source: [A32 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec03-F38 | anchor: A32
A new applicant, an other-state transfer or a holder whose Idaho license expired at least twenty-five months must take the knowledge test. [A32]
Source: [A32 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec03-F39 | anchor: A32
Idaho’s knowledge-test questions draw their information from the Driver’s Handbook. [A32]
Source: [A32 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec03-F40 | anchor: A32
The Idaho knowledge test contains forty questions. [A32]
Source: [A32 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec03-F41 | anchor: A32
An applicant can miss up to six knowledge-test questions before failing. [A32]
Source: [A32 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec03-F42 | anchor: A32
After failing the knowledge test, an applicant must wait three days before retesting. [A32]
Source: [A32 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec03-F43 | anchor: A32
A failed knowledge-test attempt requires another payment of the knowledge-test fee before retesting. [A32]
Source: [A32 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0032]

FACT_ID: sec03-F44 | anchor: A30
An Idaho credential that is lost, damaged or destroyed may be replaced with a duplicate. [A30]
Source: [A30 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0030]

FACT_ID: sec03-F45 | anchor: A31
An Idaho resident applying at a county DMV office for a duplicate after a credential is lost, stolen, damaged, destroyed or confiscated must declare the reason for replacement. [A31]
Source: [A31 -> src:rdmv-id-d:idaho-transportation-department-division:handbook:pdf-0031]

Misconceptions: Finishing a skills test successfully does not itself authorize driving before the results are recorded and the license is issued.
Mnemonic: Prepare, demonstrate and record is a teaching reminder for the skills-test sequence.
Glossary: A duplicate replaces an existing credential; a restriction limits permitted driving; a critical driving error ends the skills test with failure.
Dynamic facts: dated credential access policies, local service details and fee amounts are kept as verification debt outside the knowledge blocks.
